cards.t: Cysic Bridge Halts After Unauthorized Mint
cards.b: Cysic halted its crypto bridge following an unauthorized mint of 10 million CYS tokens. The incident was contained to bridge message processing and minting, leaving the mainnet and other systems unaffected.

per.CYS: Hit by an unauthorized mint of 10 million tokens, prompting a bridge halt.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact date of the exploit and recovery timeline.
